ttm_revenue_m.source: FY2025 revenue $529.8M (20-F XBRL us-gaap:Revenues) less nine months 2025 $302.1M plus nine months 2026 $1,962.1M (NBIS 6-K Exhibit 99.1, Q3 2026 release (sources/6k-q3-2026-release-ex99-1.htm.gz))
ttm_revenue_m.note: Q3 2026 revenue $980.8M (LSEG consensus $907.5M, CNBC), of which $325.1M point-in-time strategic-partnership revenue (6-K Ex. 99.2 Note 15; $409.1M over nine months); AI cloud revenue $973.8M. Nine-month 2026 adjusted EBITDA $831.5M; Q3 2026 group adjusted EBITDA $465.8M (47.5%); AI cloud $518.2M (53.2%) including partnership revenue. Q3 net loss from continuing operations $37.5M; Q3 capex $7,300.4M

ttm_ocf_m.source: FY2025 operating cash flow $384.8M (20-F XBRL) less nine months 2025 $-432.4M plus nine months 2026 $4,231.1M (NBIS 6-K Exhibit 99.1, Q3 2026 release (sources/6k-q3-2026-release-ex99-1.htm.gz))
ttm_ocf_m.note: Includes $7,829.0M of deferred-revenue inflow in nine months 2026, offset by a $3,333.9M rise in receivables

cash_m.source: NBIS 6-K Exhibit 99.2, Q3 2026 financial statements (sources/6k-q3-2026-ex99d2.htm.gz), balance sheet
cash_m.note: Unrestricted cash and cash equivalents; $1,215.5M of restricted cash secures financings and is excluded. The scaffold took the 2025-12-31 20-F figure

total_debt_m.source: NBIS 6-K Exhibit 99.2, Q3 2026 financial statements (sources/6k-q3-2026-ex99d2.htm.gz), Note 12 (principal amount outstanding)
total_debt_m.note: Eight convertible note series at their accreted maturity amounts ($15,726.2M) plus the $751.8M MUFG term loan; carrying value $14,162.8M. Excludes the $3.5B Citi facility signed 2026-10-22 and $1.77B of non-current operating lease liabilities

shares_outstanding_m.note: 259,597,352 Class A and 33,305,053 Class B; excludes 29,138,539 treasury shares

diluted_shares_m.note: Shares outstanding plus pre-funded warrants plus 5,493,478 unvested RSUs; convertible notes (about 68.2M shares at conversion prices $51.45-$324.65) are added only when a case's value exceeds the conversion price times the series' accretion ratio; pre-funded warrant shares 21,065,936 (NVIDIA, March 2026, $2,000M)

net_debt_m.note: Excludes $9,409.2M of deferred revenue (customer prepayments; current $1,445.5M, non-current $7,963.7M) and adds back nothing for $1,603.9M of non-marketable equity stakes (ClickHouse, Toloka) at book. RPO $38.7B at September 30 (40% within 24 months)

enterprise_value_m.source: market_cap_m plus net_debt_m; excludes deferred revenue
